This non‑retaliation framework ensures the employee can raise concerns about the breach without fear of punitive repercussions.

question: What permissions and security controls govern exporting unhashed customer telemetry for fine-tuning external generative AI models?
answer: **Permissions & Security Controls for Exporting Unhashed Customer Telemetry**  - **Export Prohibition**   - Raw (unhashed) customer telemetry **may not be exported** outside of Tesla‑controlled enclaves.       - *Source:* **TSLA‑ETH‑2026‑02**, Section **4.1 – Prohibition of Exporting Raw Telemetry Outside Enclaves** (referenced in the “AI AND GENERATIVE MODEL TRAINING REGULATIONS” block)【Chunk 1】.  - **Fine‑Tuning Restrictions**   - Fine‑tuning any third‑party generative‑AI model with Tesla customer data is **restricted** and requires explicit authorization; the default stance is **prohibited**.       - *Source:* **TSLA‑ETH‑2026‑02**, Section **4.2 – Restrictions on Fine‑Tuning Third‑Party Generative AI Models**【Chunk 1】.  - **Shadow‑AI Tool Ban**   - Employees are **strictly prohibited** from copying customer telemetry (or any other proprietary data) into commercial, unvetted external AI tools or public web chatbots (e.g., free ChatGPT, public Claude).       - *Source:* **TSLA‑ETH‑2026‑05**, Section **4.2 – Prohibition of Unauthorized Shadow AI Tools**【Chunk 2】.  - **Approved AI Environment**   - All AI‑assisted development, including any model training or fine‑tuning, must be performed on **approved internal Tesla AI instances** (e.g., internal coding copilot hosted on local‑cluster enclaves).       - *Source:* **TSLA‑ETH‑2026‑05**, Section **4.2**【Chunk 2】.  - **Violation Example**   - Exporting 50,000 unredacted customer support logs to an open external AI endpoint **violates** the export prohibition (Section 4.1) and the fine‑tuning restrictions (Section 3.1).       - *Source:* **TSLA‑ETH‑2026‑02**, Case Study 2 (references Section 4.1)【Chunk 3】.  ---  ### Summary - **No permission** is granted to export unhashed customer telemetry for external model fine‑tuning.   - **Security controls** enforce that telemetry remains within secure enclaves, prohibit use of external AI services, and require the use of vetted internal AI platforms.    Any attempt to export or fine‑tune external generative AI models with raw telemetry must first obtain a documented exception from the appropriate compliance authority; otherwise, it is a direct policy violation.
